goals.name: three-orders
goals.goal: Log in, then buy the Sauce Labs Backpack, the Sauce Labs Bike Light, and the Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket as three separate orders. For each: add the one item, open the cart, check out with the customer details, continue, finish, then go back to the products for the next item.

goals.name: cheapest-two
goals.goal: Log in, sort the products by price low to high, add the two cheapest products to the cart, check out with the customer details, and finish the order.
